opening.argument: The presentation centers on a front-running and sandwich-trading bot as an income mechanism. It explains that “the victim transaction gets sandwiched between ours” and claims users can “profit off the slippage difference in the transaction.” Viewers are instructed to fund the contract with BNB, while larger funding is presented as producing larger transactions and more profit. The speaker further claims that “it will automatically send 90% of the profits” back to the viewer’s wallet and reports weekly returns of more than five BNB, with higher weeks possible. Although a risk disclaimer limits the claim, the bot, its code, and its outcomes are not independently verified.
